templates.name: AcceptInvite
templates.summary: The page a workspace invite links to: who invited you, to what and as what, and Join or Decline; or why the invite can't be used any more.

templates.name: AccountSecurity
templates.summary: Changing the password, turning two-step verification on and off, the devices signed in, each with Sign out, and deleting the account.

templates.name: ActivityLog
templates.summary: What people did in a workspace, newest first: who, what and when, with a search, a type filter, more on request and an export. It's the record an admin checks after something changes.

templates.name: AddressBook
templates.summary: The addresses you've saved for delivery, one of them the default, each edited, removed or made the default in place.

templates.name: Agenda
templates.summary: The sessions of each day by time, filtered by track, saved to your own agenda, with clashes said.

templates.name: ApiKeys
templates.summary: The keys a workspace's scripts and tools use: what each may do, when it was last used, making a new one that's shown once, and revoking one after asking.

templates.name: Appointment
templates.summary: A time with someone, picked by day and then by time, with your details and a confirmation.

templates.name: Approvals
templates.summary: The requests waiting on you, such as expenses, leave and purchases, each with what you need to decide. Approve in one press with Undo, or decline with a reason the asker will read.

templates.name: Article
templates.summary: One post of a blog, a changelog or a help article: where it sits, who wrote it and when, its sections, and what to read next.

templates.name: Billing
templates.summary: The plan with what it costs and the day it renews, how much of it is used, how it's paid (a card, a direct debit or an e-wallet), past invoices, and a cancel that takes no more steps than signing up did.

templates.name: Booking
templates.summary: A stay at one place: the day the guests arrive and the day they leave, picked on two months side by side, with the nights already booked named, the price worked out, and a way to reserve.

templates.name: ConsentBanner
templates.summary: Asks once whether optional cookies may be set, with accepting and rejecting one click each, and lets the answer be changed at any time. It sits at the top of the page, in the flow, so it never covers what someone is reading or the control they're on.

templates.name: ContactForm
templates.summary: A message to the people behind a product, with what they need to answer it, and an answer to say it arrived.

templates.name: CourseOverview
templates.summary: A course's modules and lessons, how far you are, where to carry on, and marking lessons done.

templates.name: Dashboard
templates.summary: The page an account lands on: the key numbers for the month, how much of the plan is used, the latest projects and what the team did. It shows skeletons while the data loads, and a first-run state before there's anything to count.

templates.name: DataExport
templates.summary: Choose what to include and in which format, see how big it will be, ask for it, and download it before its link runs out.

templates.name: DataImport
templates.summary: Bringing records in from a spreadsheet: choose a CSV file, match its columns to the app's fields, check every row before anything is saved, then see what was added, updated and skipped.

templates.name: DetailPage
templates.summary: One thing, here a project: where it sits, its name and details, its parts in tabs, small removals you can undo, and a delete you can't, behind typing its name.

templates.name: Donation
templates.summary: Give once or every month, choose an amount that says what it pays for, cover the card fee if you like, and see the total before you give.

templates.name: EmailPreferences
templates.summary: The page an email's "Manage emails" or "Unsubscribe" link opens, with no sign-in: which emails come, a switch for each, and one button to stop them all.

templates.name: ErrorPages
templates.summary: Four pages for when the page someone asked for can't be shown: not found (404), offline, a server error (500) and no access (403). Each says what happened, says what to do about it without blaming anyone, and leaves a way back.

templates.name: EventRegistration
templates.summary: When and where an event is, how many places are left, and a short form to get tickets, or to join the waiting list once it's full.

templates.name: ExpenseReport
templates.summary: Add what you spent, one expense at a time, see them in a table with the total, and send the report to be paid back.

templates.name: FeedbackSurvey
templates.summary: A few questions after something happened, such as a visit, an order or a call: a rating, what you came to do, what could be better, your own words, and whether we may write back.

templates.name: FileBrowser
templates.summary: One folder's files as a list people pick from: move or delete several at once, with Undo, and rename, move or delete any one from its row.

templates.name: GiftCard
templates.summary: Choose an amount and a design, say who it's for and when to send it, see what they'll get, and add it to the bag.

templates.name: HelpCenter
templates.summary: The topics people come for, the common questions with a search, and a way to write to a person that says when they'll answer.

templates.name: Integrations
templates.summary: The other apps a workspace can connect: which are connected, connecting one, and disconnecting one after asking. It's the page an admin opens to make your app work with the tools their team already uses.

templates.name: Invoice
templates.summary: One bill, as the person paying it reads it: whether it's due, paid or overdue, who it's from and to, its lines, the totals, and a way to pay or keep a copy.

templates.name: JobApplication
templates.summary: What a job is, one short form to apply with a CV, and what happens next.

templates.name: Leaderboard
templates.summary: Who's ahead this week, this month or of all time, where you are, and who's moving.

templates.name: LeaveRequest
templates.summary: Time off, asked for on a calendar: the working days counted, weekends and holidays left out and named, the balance that's left, and the requests already made with where each one is.

templates.name: ListDetail
templates.summary: A list of things beside the one that's open, like messages in an inbox: two panes on a wide screen, one at a time on a phone.

templates.name: ListSearch
templates.summary: A page of rows to search, filter, sort, select and page through, with the view kept in the address so Back, a reload and a shared link all show the same list.

templates.name: Messages
templates.summary: One-to-one conversations: the list beside the open one, each row named by the person with how many are unread, and a field to write in that says who will read it.

templates.name: MultiStepForm
templates.summary: A long form split into short steps: here an application for a business account, with three steps of questions, then every answer shown before anything is sent, then what happens next. It's built on Stepper and its `useSteps` hook.

templates.name: Notifications
templates.summary: A bell in the Navbar that opens the latest notifications in a drawer, and a full inbox page with a filter, Mark as read and Mark all as read. Both read the same list.

templates.name: Onboarding
templates.summary: The first page a new account sees: a welcome, a checklist of setup steps with how far along it is, and an empty project list that says what to do first. Progress is kept between visits, so nobody does a step twice.

templates.name: OrderHistory
templates.summary: Every order you've placed, newest first, found by what was in it or by where it's got to, each with a way to see it and to buy it again.

templates.name: OrderStatus
templates.summary: Where an order is after it's placed: its stage as a sentence, the steps it goes through, what happened and when, what's in it, and a way to cancel while that's still possible.

templates.name: PasswordReset
templates.summary: Getting back into an account after forgetting its password: an email with a link, then a new password chosen from that link. It's where Sign in's "Forgot your password?" leads.

templates.name: PermissionRequest
templates.summary: Asks the browser for the camera (or the microphone, location, notifications, the clipboard) only when someone chooses to use it, says why just before, and keeps the page working when the answer is no.

templates.name: Poll
templates.summary: One question, a few answers and a vote; then the results so far, with yours marked, and a way to change it while it's open.

templates.name: PriceEstimate
templates.summary: Choose a plan, how many people and any extras, and see what it costs, line by line, as you go.

templates.name: ProductCompare
templates.summary: Two to four products side by side, a row for each thing they could differ on, and a way to see only the differences.

templates.name: ProductPage
templates.summary: One product in a shop: its pictures, its price, the choices to make (a color, a size), how many, and Add to cart, which says what went in.

templates.name: Profile
templates.summary: What other people see of you: a photo, your name, a short bio, where you are and a link, edited in one form and saved when you say so.

templates.name: Quiz
templates.summary: A few questions to check what was learned, all on one page, then the score and, for each question, whether it was right and why.

templates.name: Recipe
templates.summary: What it is and how long it takes, the ingredients for as many people as you're cooking for, ticked off as you gather them, and the steps in order, ticked off as you go.

templates.name: Referral
templates.summary: Invite friends with your own link or by email, and see who joined and what you've earned.

templates.name: ReturnRequest
templates.summary: Sending back some of an order: which items and why, how they go back, where the money goes, and what happens next.

templates.name: Reviews
templates.summary: The average and how the stars split, then the reviews themselves, filtered by stars and sorted, a few at a time, each one marked helpful or not.

templates.name: RolePermissions
templates.summary: What each role in a workspace can do, as a grid of checkboxes, where a permission that needs another brings it along, and nothing changes until Save.

templates.name: SavedItems
templates.summary: Things kept for later, with what changed since they were saved, and a way to move each to the cart or let it go.

templates.name: SendMoney
templates.summary: Choose who, say how much, see what they'll get, check it all on a review step, then send.

templates.name: SessionTimeout
templates.summary: Warns well before a signed-in session ends, lets one action keep it going, and loses nothing typed if it ends anyway.

templates.name: SettingsForm
templates.summary: A settings page made of sections, each with its own Save, its own errors and its own status, that asks before unsaved changes are lost.

templates.name: ShareDialog
templates.summary: Who can open one document and what each person may do: add people by email, change or remove someone's access, set what the link alone allows, and copy the link.

templates.name: SignAgreement
templates.summary: An agreement to read in a box of its own, a box to tick that you agree, and your signature, drawn or typed.

templates.name: SignIn
templates.summary: An email and a password, then a one-time code, as one page. It meets WCAG 2.2's accessible authentication (3.3.8): nothing to remember or work out beyond the password itself.

templates.name: SignUp
templates.summary: A new account in two short steps: name, email, an optional phone, a password and the terms, then a code from the email to show it's theirs.

templates.name: StatusPage
templates.summary: Whether it's working now, each service's last 90 days, what's being done about a problem, and updates by email.

templates.name: StockCount
templates.summary: A shop's stock counted shelf by shelf, typed into a grid like a spreadsheet, with what differs from the record said as it goes.

templates.name: StoreLocator
templates.summary: Find a shop by town or postcode, or by where you are, with each one's distance, whether it's open now, its hours and directions.

templates.name: SupportTicket
templates.summary: One request to a support team, as the person who asked sees it: where it's got to, the conversation so far, and a reply box, or a way to reopen it once solved.

templates.name: TaskBoard
templates.summary: A team's tasks in columns, one per stage: cards move between them and are saved as they move, a move that can't be saved goes back and says so, and a new task is added from a dialog.

templates.name: TeamCalendar
templates.summary: A team's events by month, week, day or as a list: add one from a form, open one to see when it is, move one by dragging or by keyboard, and delete one with Undo.

templates.name: TeamMembers
templates.summary: Who is on a team and what each person may do: change a role in place, invite people by email, resend or revoke an invite, and remove someone with Undo.

templates.name: Timesheet
templates.summary: A week's hours by project and day, the totals as you type, and sending it for approval.

templates.name: Transactions
templates.summary: An account's money in and out by month, found by what it was or its category, with the month's totals first.

templates.name: WhatsNew
templates.summary: The product's changes, newest first, by month: what's new since your last visit marked, a filter by kind, and older months on request.

templates.name: WriteReview
templates.summary: Stars, a few words and, if you like, photos, for something you bought; then a thank-you that says when it will show.

templates.name: AIChat
templates.summary: A conversation with an assistant whose replies stream in: suggested prompts to start, Stop while a reply arrives, and Copy and Regenerate once it's whole. It's built from Chat, ChatMessage, ChatComposer, CopyButton and Button.

templates.name: ActivityFeed
templates.summary: Who did what and when, newest first, with Load more at the end. It's built from Timeline, Avatar, RelativeTime and LoadMore.

templates.name: AuthCard
templates.summary: The sign-in card from the [Sign-in pattern](?path=/docs/patterns-sign-in--docs), as a block you place on your own page: email and password, then a one-time code, then signed in. The pattern is this card on a page of its own, so the two share one piece of code. It meets WCAG 2.2's accessible authentication (3.3.8).

templates.name: CartSummary
templates.summary: What's in the cart, with a quantity and Remove for each item, a coupon, and the sums down to the total, before people check out. It's built from NumberInput, Input with an Apply action, DescriptionList, Button and Toast.

templates.name: EmptyStates
templates.summary: The four empty states most apps need. Each one says what happened in words and offers the next step as a real button or link. They're built from EmptyState.

templates.name: Faq
templates.summary: Questions and answers in groups, with a search field and "Still stuck?" at the end. It's built from Accordion, SearchInput and Highlight.

templates.name: Footer
templates.summary: The site's footer: link groups, a language picker, a theme picker and the legal line. It's built from Heading, Link, Field, Select and Button.

templates.name: PageHeader
templates.summary: The top of a page inside an app: where the page is, what it's called, what it's for, and what you can do there.

templates.name: Pricing
templates.summary: Plans side by side, billed monthly or yearly. Each plan says what it includes and has one clear action. It's built from Card, SegmentedControl, Badge and Button.

templates.name: ProductGrid
templates.summary: Product cards in a grid that fits the screen, for a shop's category, search or "new this week" page. Each card has a picture, the name as the link to the product, the price, the rating and Add to cart. It's built from Card, Image, Heading, Link, Badge, Rating, Button and Toast.

templates.name: SettingsSection
templates.summary: One group of settings with its own heading, its own Save, its own status and its own error summary. A settings page stacks several.

templates.name: StatsRow
templates.summary: A row of key numbers for the top of a dashboard. Each number shows how it changed, in words as well as color, and can have a trend line.

templates.name: TableToolbar
templates.summary: The controls above a table: a search field, filters, a count of the results, and actions for the selected rows.
